game_title: Times Table Garden – Mossy Creek Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mystic Forest – Mossy Creek, a mossy forest creek: the druid must handle giant beetles while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Times Table Garden: Plant a grid of vine ropes using nested for loops for rows and columns.
theme: Mystic Forest – Mossy Creek: a mossy forest creek
core_gameplay_loop: In Mossy Creek, repeat each round: Plant a grid of vine ropes using nested for loops for rows and columns. Each round, a new vine ropes challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the garden_cells value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 150 points of vine ropes by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 150, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Times Table Garden
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Times Table Garden' (Week 5 slot 6), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Mossy Creek'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how garden_cells changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant beetles in Mossy Creek.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 150 within 55 seconds.
